pos_neg_margin_category_breakdown.category_breakdown_unavailable_reason: Item categories are not provided by this benchmark.

metric_definitions.embedding_collapse_score: Range ~[0,1]. Estimated by mean pairwise cosine similarity of sampled item embeddings (mapped to [0,1]). Higher means embeddings point in similar directions (worse diversity / more collapse).
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_mean: Mean of (pos_logit - neg_logit) over valid positions; higher means clearer separation.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_p10: 10th percentile of (pos_logit - neg_logit); lower suggests many hard/confusing cases.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_neg_beats_pos_rate: Fraction where neg_logit > pos_logit (margin < 0); lower is better.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_small_margin_rate: Fraction where (pos_logit - neg_logit) < eps; higher means weak separation.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_category_breakdown: Reports valid training-position counts and counts of low-margin (margin<eps) and wrong-rank (margin<0) cases. Category breakdowns are unavailable because item category labels are not provided; empty category lists are not measured zero category counts. If valid_positions is zero, margin summary values are placeholders and must not be interpreted as measured separation.
